estimate_depth_from_images: estimate depth from input images using the Monodepth2Model with a ResnetEncoder and DepthDecoder
initialize_monodepth2_model: initialize a Monodepth2Model that downloads pretrained encoder and depth decoder weights from Google Cloud Storage
set_model_to_eval_mode: set the Monodepth2Model encoder and depth decoder to evaluation mode for inference
set_model_to_train_mode: set the Monodepth2Model encoder and depth decoder to training mode for fine-tuning
get_model_parameters: get all trainable parameters from the Monodepth2Model encoder and depth decoder as a list
